name: Grade 9 IT Practice: March Week 2 - Blink and Signals
description: Practice words for Grade 9 first-trimester physical computing work.

words.definition: Using clear separate values, like on or off.
words.example: The digital pin turned the LED fully on or fully off.

words.definition: Using values that can change smoothly.
words.example: The analog reading changed gradually as the sensor value changed.

words.definition: A sign or message sent by a system.
words.example: The signal told the Arduino when to change the LED state.

words.definition: A circuit output light controlled by Arduino code.
words.example: The LED blinked after the sketch uploaded successfully.
The blink pattern turned the LED on, waited, and turned it off.

words.definition: The part of a program that runs first.
words.example: The setup section told the Arduino which pin would be an output.

words.definition: The Arduino section that repeats the signal pattern.
words.example: The loop repeated the blink pattern until the board was unplugged.
The delay made the LED wait one second before changing.
